topic: hash-authenticated local snapshot preflight and snapshot-specific timeout

sources.fact: Offline/firewalled Transformers use requires downloaded/cached files ahead of time; HF_HUB_OFFLINE and local_files_only support local loading.
Hub downloads are cached/version-aware, full commit hashes are required for commit revisions, and snapshot_download downloads an entire repo revision.
HF_HUB_OFFLINE prevents HTTP calls and requires cache availability.
Safetensors headers can be parsed without loading the whole tensor buffer, so structure and full digest authenticity are distinct.

applied_change: require pinned model.safetensors SHA-256 in live preflight/capture path and separate snapshot materializer timeout from generic probe timeout
